title.en: An Act Granting to Miguel Perez a Franchise to Install, Operate, and Maintain An Electric Light, Heat and Power Plant in the Municipality of Pontevedra, Province of Occidental Negros, Philippine Islands.

text.en:
Subject to the rules and conditions established in Act Numbered Thirty-six hundred and
thirty-six, there is hereby granted to Miguel Perez, for a period of fifty years from the approval of this Act, the
right, privilege, and authority to construct, maintain, and operate an electric light, heat and power system for
the purpose of generating and distributing electric light, heat and power, for sale within the limits of the
municipality of Pontevedra, Province of Occidental Negros, Philippine Islands.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, November 20, 1931.
